algorithmModal.title: CertifAI SRS Engine: SuperMemo SM-2 & FSRS
algorithmModal.subtitle: Why reviewing 17 targeted cards beats blindly flipping through 500 flashcards
algorithmModal.ebbinghausDesc: Without spaced repetition, the human brain forgets 70% of complex technical concepts within 48 hours. CertifAI's SRS engine calculates the exact date when recall probability drops below 85%, scheduling reviews at the mathematically optimal moment.
algorithmModal.idDesc: Each flashcard (e.g., Card #127) has its own independent review history model.
algorithmModal.diffDesc: Dynamically adapts to your responses. Hesitant recalls raise difficulty to 4 or 5/5.
algorithmModal.nextReviewTitle: 3. Next Review to the Exact Day
algorithmModal.repDesc: Statistical tracking of retention (e.g., 4 consecutive recalls, 75% success rate).
algorithmModal.sm2FormulaNote: Where q is your recall grade (1 = Again, 3 = Hard, 4 = Good, 5 = Easy).
